name: NetBird
author: Michael Benner
description: NetBird status, peer browsing, and quick copy actions in the Omarchy bar.

barWidget.description: Toggle NetBird, browse peers, and copy peer IPs or names.

schema.label: Icon style
schema.description: theme draws the NetBird mark in your theme's colours and follows a theme switch; color shows NetBird's own coloured tray artwork.

schema.label: Admin console URL
schema.description: Overrides the derived admin console link. Left empty the URL comes from the management URL, and NetBird Cloud maps to https://app.netbird.io automatically — set this only for a split dashboard host of your own.
